member.name: Meera
member.visual_descriptor: An adult Indian woman model, mid-to-late 20s, confident and elegant. She has warm brown skin, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, bold defined eyebrows, sharp facial features, and a magnetic gaze. Her eyes look confident, intense, slightly mysterious, and glamorous. She has long, healthy black hair styled in soft waves with a polished, modern look. Her makeup is refined and glamorous, with strong eyeliner, defined lashes, glowing skin, and a soft nude or rose-toned lip. She wears a stylish modern outfit with subtle Indian elegance, such as a fitted dress, statement earrings, or a chic Indo-western look. Her posture is upright, graceful, and composed. Overall vibe: attractive, confident, elegant, feminine, charismatic, polished, and high-fashion.
member.personality: She is confident, stylish, emotionally strong, composed, and self-assured. She carries herself with quiet confidence and calm control. She is graceful, intelligent, charming, and slightly mysterious. Her presence feels magnetic and cinematic. She blends modern global fashion poise with Indian cultural elegance. She is attractive but sophisticated, playful but composed, expressive but never aggressive. Her actions should stay calm, graceful, controlled, and safe: no running, lunging, shoving, sharp pointing, slamming, fighting, scolding, intimidating, or threatening gestures. When singing or lip-syncing, her mouth movement should stay soft, relaxed, and elegant: no shouting, no yelling expression, no aggressive rap delivery, and no wide-open mouth shapes. She expresses confidence through subtle smiles, relaxed posture, slow head turns, gentle hand gestures, and smooth high-fashion movement.
